description: The bar chart compares the scores of three different models, SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-7B, across four different benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 35 to 80, while the horizontal axis lists the benchmarks. In the MathVista benchmark, SRPO-7B scored the highest with 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B with 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-7B with 68.2. In the MathVerse benchmark, the scores were 55.8 for SRPO-7B, 52.9 for GRPO-7B, and 46.3 for Qwen-2.5-7B. The MMMU-Pro benchmark showed SRPO-7B with 42.3, GRPO-7B with 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-7B with 36.9. Lastly, in the Physics benchmark, SRPO-7B scored 60.6, GRPO-7B scored 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-7B scored 45.4. The bars are color-coded with SRPO-7B in dark blue, GRPO-7B in medium blue, and Qwen-2.5-7B in light blue. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
